lines.say: Looking for a Zoho consultant in Sydney or Auckland? The postcode matters less than you think.
lines.show: Looking for a Zoho consultant in Sydney or Auckland? The postcode matters less than you think.

lines.say: Zoho work happens in your own account, online. Local or remote, it's the same screens.
lines.show: Zoho work happens in your own account, online. Local or remote, it's the same screens.

lines.say: Go local for on-site workshops, accounting-led projects, or a contract under local law.
lines.show: Go local for on-site workshops, accounting-led projects, or a contract under local law.

lines.say: Go remote for defined builds. Creator apps, Dell-yoodge scripts, integrations.
lines.show: Go remote for defined builds. Creator apps, Deluge scripts, integrations.

lines.say: Either way, create the Zoho account yourself. Check it signs in at zoho dot com dot A U.
lines.show: Either way, create the Zoho account yourself. Check it signs in at zoho.com.au.

lines.say: Ask where everyone who logs in is based. In Australia, overseas access is usually a disclosure under A P P eight.
lines.show: Ask where everyone who logs in is based. In Australia, overseas access is usually a disclosure under APP 8.

lines.say: Get their hours in your time zone, summer and winter. And check G S T with your accountant.
